summary.who_and_where: Rosa, a laundromat attendant in her late thirties, is closing a small neighbourhood laundromat late at night.
summary.what_happens: She checks the last running dryer, finds a forgotten red scarf inside and decides to wait for its owner instead of locking up.
summary.what_we_read: She is exhausted but will not leave someone else's things behind.
summary.purpose: Demo project: shows the schema -> prompt pipeline. All people and places are fictional.

style.style: Ordinary smartphone video, vertical or horizontal as specified. Looks like real footage a friend shot, not an ad. NOT cinematic, NOT 3D render, NOT stock footage.
style.operating_style: Handheld by an untrained friend: micro-jitter, one brief autofocus hunt, mild exposure pumping, slight rolling-shutter wobble, headroom not quite right, off-centre framing.
style.lighting: Whatever light the place has: uneven, unflattering, mixed colour temperature (window daylight + warm ceiling LED). No beauty light, no studio light.
style.color_accent_doctrine: Phone colour science: slightly oversharpened, compressed highlights, crushed blacks, fine sensor noise in shadows.
style.texture: Real worn objects, fingerprints on glass, scuffed surfaces, cables, clutter allowed.
style.camera_lens: Phone main lens ~26mm equivalent, deep depth of field, no shallow cinematic bokeh.
style.skin: Ordinary working person, NOT a model, NOT a beauty influencer: pores, vellus hair, under-eye shadows, uneven tone, a small blemish, forehead shine, asymmetric face. No makeup-ad look.
style.acting: Nothing performed. One or two micro-actions per shot (glance up, blink, exhale, shift weight). No acting toward the lens.
style.physics: Real weight and inertia; hands actually grip objects; fabric responds.
style.composition: Casual, slightly wrong: subject off-centre, background clutter visible.
style.continuity: Same person, same clothes, same room across all shots.
style.technical: Real-time 30 fps look, no slow motion, no morphing, no warping.
style.audio: Phone microphone: room reverb, distant traffic, handling noise, gain rises when the room goes quiet. No music, no narration, no subtitles.

negative_extra: no cinematic look, no shallow cinematic bokeh, no glamour lighting, no makeup ad look, no model face

characters.name: Rosa
characters.traits: late thirties, short dark curly hair, tired eyes, a small scar on the chin, ordinary build
characters.wardrobe: faded green work apron over a grey long-sleeve tee

locations.name: Laundromat
locations.description: small neighbourhood laundromat at night: two rows of white dryers, tiled floor, plastic chairs, a folding table, a notice board with blank papers
locations.light: cold fluorescent tubes; dark street behind the glass door

props.name: Scarf
props.description: a long knitted red wool scarf with frayed ends

shots.title: Last dryer
shots.scene_context: closing time, the room is empty
shots.first_frame: Rosa at 40%x/55%y in front of a row of dryers, only the third one still spinning; the street door at the right edge, dark outside
shots.camera: handheld by a coworker, small breathing jitter, no push-in

beats.action: Rosa walks to the spinning dryer and leans in to read its timer
the drum stops; she opens the door and pulls out a red scarf

acting.behaviour: rubs her left eye with the back of her wrist, one slow exhale through the nose

shots.physics: warm air puffs out of the dryer; the scarf is heavy and slightly damp at one end
shots.lighting: cold fluorescent tubes overhead, one tube flickers faintly

audio.sfx: dryer drum slowing to a stop, metal door latch

shots.what_we_read: she is too tired to care, until she sees the scarf
shots.purpose: set up the place and the found object
locks: the scarf is red in every frame
shots.clutter: a lost sock on the folding table, a crumpled receipt on the floor

shots.title: Decision
shots.first_frame: Rosa at 50%x/45%y holding the folded scarf against her chest; the street door behind her, half out of frame
shots.camera: handheld, the operator takes half a step back at 2s

beats.action: she looks at the door, then up at a wall clock off-screen
she hooks a plastic chair with her foot, pulls it out and sits down

acting.behaviour: a small resigned half-smile, shoulders drop

shots.physics: the chair legs catch on a tile seam

audio.sfx: plastic chair legs scraping on tile

locks: same apron and scarf as shot 1
